svg.text: Tracks for the enduro fork: dashes only, colour only, or both (proposal)
C codes roughness twice: a lightness ramp (rougher = more contrast with the land) and the shared dash ladder. TH / CH: track km per level of our classifier.
paved surface, or grade1 without surface · TH 0.7%, CH 14.8%
everything else, incl. surface=unpaved and no tags · TH 98.0%, CH 71.0%
smoothness very_bad/horrible, grade4 to 7, mud, rock, 4wd_only · TH 1.2%, CH 14.1%
path with motorcycle=yes: track ramp at path width
path without motorcycle access: a cool colour, never on the ramp
motorcycle, motor_vehicle or access no, private...: faded
style 4, light tan fill: stays a road, wider, with an outline
